title: Threshold Object Across Temporal Scale
observed_structure: An unfamiliar object recurs at transitions between materially different states or eras.
Symmetry, scale, silence, and temporal matching make the object function as a threshold rather than an explained symbol.
misuse_risks: mystery object without causal state change
transferable_structure: Repeat an unfamiliar threshold object across escalating states or times, using formal continuity to connect otherwise discontinuous transformations.
non_transferable_surface: Do not use a literal black rectangle, Jupiter alignment, ape staging, or copied graphic match.
